g.text: R8B · held-out questions on previously seen textbooks · simulated user replies

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20252b
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414852

g.text: Sufficient inputs: asked 0/24; resolved 0; unknown 0; unresolved asks 0.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414852

g.text: Underspecified inputs: asked 1/24; resolved 1; unknown 0; unresolved asks 0.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: 48 held-out inputs in total; six families contribute to both groups. Languages and formal/colloquial styles remain in each denominator.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: AI-authored inputs, AI-reviewed evidence labels, and simulated replies; this is not a real-student or teacher-gold evaluation.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: Resolved is model-reported; unknown replies are a subset of unresolved asks. All unresolved, fallback, and failure cases are retained.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: Panels use different interpretations and must not be pooled as a single accuracy score. Point estimates; paired intervals are in the report.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: First-stage retrieval only, at most 20 candidates per policy. No reranking, answer generation, or end-to-end outcome measurement.
